title: Tim Taylor's sun-gazing protocols in American Cosmic
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tim Taylor's sun-gazing protocols in American Cosmic, about 2010s at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Tim Taylor talks about in Diana's book, American Cosmic, that he's his protocols are around, you know, you know, being in the sunlight, looking at the sun.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Tim Taylor, a man he describes as a NASA rocket scientist, talks about his personal routines, which he calls protocols, in American Cosmic, a book by Diana Pasulka. According to Michels, those routines involve being out in the sunlight and looking at the sun. He tells it as a clue to how Taylor says he connects with whatever he experiences.
